auth.challengeExpired: That sign-in took too long. Start again.
auth.codeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired.
auth.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
auth.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in a few minutes.
auth.codeWrong: That code isn't right. Check your authenticator app and try again.
auth.emailUnverified: Verify your email address before signing in.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we'll send a code to set a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If {email} has an account, a code is on its way. Enter it with your new password.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.oauth.closed: There's no account for this {provider} address, and sign-up is closed.
auth.oauth.email: {provider} didn't share a verified email. Verify one there and try again.
auth.oauth.state: The sign-in link expired. Try again.
auth.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor. Each works once.
auth.registerHint: One account for every brain you run or share.
auth.registrationFailed: We couldn't create the account. The email may already be registered — try signing in.
auth.resetDone: Your password is set. Every other session was signed out.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session changed. Reload the page and try again.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.twoFactorIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.unavailable: This isn't available on this server yet.
auth.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed you to finish setting up your account.
